body:
> This appears to have worked in 7.8 

@costin which version of 7.8 did you test it with and found it working? I went all the way to 7.0.0 and I couldn't find any version it ever worked with. The error message and the type of the exception flipped from `number_format_exception` to `illegal_argument_exception` between 7.0 and 7.2, but it was always returning a failure in 7.x as far as I can see. Perhaps, I am missing something in my reproduction, could you take a look? 

I am running the following script to reproduce it: [test.sh](https://gist.github.com/imotov/0ff04312ecfd32a97d3d7d4d47e6477c#file-test-sh)

I am getting pretty much the same result in [7.3.0](https://gist.github.com/imotov/0ff04312ecfd32a97d3d7d4d47e6477c#file-result-7-3-0), [7.8.0](https://gist.github.com/imotov/0ff04312ecfd32a97d3d7d4d47e6477c#file-result-7-8-0) and [7.11.1](https://gist.github.com/imotov/0ff04312ecfd32a97d3d7d4d47e6477c#file-result-7-11-1) 

I am getting a slightly different result in [7.0.0](https://gist.github.com/imotov/0ff04312ecfd32a97d3d7d4d47e6477c#file-result-7-0-0), but it is still an error.
